data.name: Saaravenn Fen Confederacy
data.short_lore: The Saaravenn Fen Confederacy is a loose oath-moot of reed-boat clans who swear fealty to no throne. Their ambushers vanish into the black waters of Vaarun Marsh, and no toll-collector from the river-guilds has returned from the reed-mazes around Lohvaara. Now salt caravans press into the eastern shallows, and forest wardens eye the fen's timber.

towns.name: Heeluma
towns.blurb: Reed-boat yard where every clan's oath-stone is carved; its smoke-hung docks build the fastest hulls in the fen.

towns.name: Kaarnesta
towns.blurb: Stilt market on the black lake, famed for eel-smoked fish and a grudge against the river-guild toll-barges.

towns.name: Ruunhaavi
towns.blurb: Moot-island town where the oath-moot meets each midsummer; its bell is rung only when a clan breaks faith.

towns.name: Liivanne
towns.blurb: Salt-marsh shrine town trading peat-fire and amber; lords of the Salt-road still pay tribute here, grudgingly.

towns.name: Tuoksimaa
towns.blurb: Fen-fever town whose herbalists brew cures from bog-myrtle; a legend says the drowned keep its wells.

towns.name: Oorvaan
towns.blurb: Frontier outpost on the forest edge, where Warden hunters and fen trappers trade furs and quarrel over timber.

castles.name: Sooraalen
castles.blurb: Ancient stilt-fort ringed by moss-walls; its keeper refuses any oath that names a king.

castles.name: Veenhalla
castles.blurb: Peat-brick hold on a sunken island; its cellars hold the clans' sworn reed-scrolls.

castles.name: Kiivarra
castles.blurb: Watchtower of oak piles over black water, guarding the only causeway into the heart of the fen.

castles.name: Lohvaara
castles.blurb: Mazed reed-fort whose paths shift with the tide; a fabled trap that swallowed a Regency host.

castles.name: Vaalikka
castles.blurb: Half-sunken chapel-keep where the oath-moot's sacred eels are kept and fed each spring.

castles.name: Nurmuun
castles.blurb: Hill-fort of turf and stone above the reed line, a lookout against salt caravans from the south.

castles.name: Hamaanne
castles.blurb: Ruined ferry-castle whose toll chain was broken by river-guild marines; the clans want it back.

castles.name: Ulvaasso
castles.blurb: Wolf-stake fortress of driftwood, said to be built on the bones of a drowned Warden-king.

castles.name: Peeruus
castles.blurb: Mist-bound keep where sword-oaths are sworn over a black stone pulled from the marsh floor.

villages.name: Akkeli
villages.blurb: Eel-weir village whose traps feed half the fen; its fishers guard their weirs with knives.

villages.name: Jaarvun
villages.blurb: Hunting hamlet on the shore of Jaarvun Mere, famed for black-feathered decoy birds.

villages.name: Sirreka
villages.blurb: Smithy village working bog-iron into arrowheads; the Salt-road caravans once tried to buy every one.

villages.name: Meelvi
villages.blurb: Beekeepers hang hives on the reed-stalks here; a grudge with the forest wardens over stolen combs.

villages.name: Otsuuk
villages.blurb: Lakeside village known for whistle-songs that carry clan signals across three miles of mist.

villages.name: Vihkuu
villages.blurb: Ferryman's hamlet where river-guild surveyors vanished; locals still leave them offerings.

villages.name: Ruokkaa
villages.blurb: Fishing village on stilts, famed for its rope of twisted sedge that holds fast in any storm.

villages.name: Tiiruus
villages.blurb: Cairn-village marking the oath-moot's boundary; its stones are said to move when a clan lies.

villages.name: Ylaaka
villages.blurb: Upland hamlet of dry reed-thatch, a rare dry patch in the fen that bandits covet.

villages.name: Kuolmi
villages.blurb: Village of bone-pit ossuaries where clans bury their dead in the peat; the living avoid it at dusk.

villages.name: Eepsaa
villages.blurb: Crossroads hamlet where mud-roads meet the causeways; it sells passage for silver to any caravan.

villages.name: Ohtaam
villages.blurb: Reed-harvest village whose annual cutting festival ends in a mock raid on the nearest town.

villages.name: Rimmaa
villages.blurb: Quarry village of soft limestone; its masons build the only stone barges in the fen.

villages.name: Mooraa
villages.blurb: Wild-goose hunters' village; its geese are said to warn of approaching river-guild galleys.

villages.name: Haapuu
villages.blurb: Birch-grove village of shamans who read oath-omens from the bark of fallen trees.

villages.name: Vesseli
villages.blurb: Salt-marsh hamlet where caravan drovers once fled raiding clans; their hidden salt-caches are rumoured.

villages.name: Gaiuuk
villages.blurb: Mudflat village famed for its reed-boat racers; wagers here have started three feuds.

villages.name: Naabeli
villages.blurb: Abandoned mill-village beside a dam built by river-guild engineers; the clans want it blown open.

villages.name: Ketsaal
villages.blurb: Hunters' outpost at the edge of the Warden woods, where a boundary-stone was pulled up at night.

villages.name: Uuvaar
villages.blurb: Mist-hung hamlet where the oldest oath-moot was first sworn; its elders dispute who may speak.

villages.name: Lauvanna
villages.blurb: Hearthstone village of smoke-cured hams and a chanting choir that greets every returning boat.
